blocks.text: Privacy Policy
Effective Date: February 12, 2026

No mobile information will be shared with third parties/affiliates for marketing/promotional purposes. Information sharing to subcontractors in support services, such as customer service, is permitted. All other use case categories exclude text messaging originator opt-in data and consent; this information will not be shared with any third parties.
Kingdom Heights Preparatory School, a ministry of The Rock Family Worship Center (“we,” “our,” or “us”), respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your information.
1. What Information We Collect
We may collect the following information when you interact with our website, Facebook/Instagram lead forms, or other official communication channels:

items: Student grade level or enrollment interest
Any information voluntarily submitted through forms

blocks.text: We may also automatically collect certain technical information such as IP address, browser type, and device information through cookies and tracking tools.
2. How User Data Is Used
We use collected information to:
We do not sell, rent, or trade personal information to third parties.
3. SMS Opt-In Details

By providing your phone number through our website or Facebook/Instagram lead forms, you consent to receive SMS communication from Kingdom Heights Preparatory School, a ministry of The Rock Family Worship Center.
SMS messages may include event reminders, enrollment information, and school updates.

items: Message and data rates may apply.
Reply STOP to opt out at any time.
Consent is not a condition of enrollment.

blocks.text: Opt-in occurs when a user voluntarily submits their phone number through an official lead form that includes SMS disclosure language.
4. Cookie & Tracking Practices
Our website may use cookies and similar tracking technologies to:
Users may adjust browser settings to refuse cookies; however, some features of the website may not function properly.
We may use third-party services such as analytics tools or social media platforms that operate under their own privacy policies.
5. Data Security & Handling
We implement reasonable administrative, technical, and physical safeguards to protect personal information from unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction.
While we strive to protect user data, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.
6. User Rights
Users may request to:
To make a request, please contact:
info@khroyals.com or sjackson@therockfwc.org 256-210-1343
7. Mobile Information Sharing Statement
No mobile information will be shared with third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes.
All other categories exclude text messaging originator opt-in data and consent; this information will not be shared with any third parties.
8. Updates to This Policy
We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Updates will be posted on this page with a revised effective date.
